title: Feature request: Allow creating notification/warning when Canula (or any other thing) has been in use for certain amount of time
symptom: User wants a warning mechanism to alert when a canula (or other consumable) has been in use for a certain time, because they use less insulin and a canula lasts 5-6 days instead of the recommended 3 days.
fix: The issue was closed as resolved by a pull request (PR #3267), but the thread does not describe the specific fix.
evidence_quote: you can close this issue due to https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3267
